tests_may_change_note: A new shared router case goes in common.case.test.ts, and every file that calls runTest() passes it a skip list as data (each router's router.test.ts, and reg-exp-router/prepared-router.test.ts); a router that cannot take a new case gets it added to that list. The upstream fix edited PatternRouter's list; the blind fix also edited RegExpRouter's and PreparedRegExpRouter's.

naive_patches.naive.patch: Keeps the first value only on the plain-segment path of TrieRouter's search, not on the path for a parameter with a pattern: `/:id/:id{[0-9]+}` still returns the second value.

hidden_tests_note: The upstream fix's own tests, moved into one file: TrieRouter node and router cases that fail on the base, and the app-level SmartRouter fallback case. The shared cases that already pass on RegExpRouter and LinearRouter are left out, because every hidden test must fail on the base.
